itens.titulo: Marvell Technology Just Gave Its Investors Great News
itens.descricao: Marvell Technology Just Gave Its Investors Great News Yahoo Finance
trechos: At around $230 billion, Marvell is a fraction of the size of Nvidia, whose market cap is well over $5 trillion.
But the business has been doing exceptionally well, and its share price is up around 200% this year.
Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.
But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase.
"Act 2" is the global rollout.
Marvell projects revenue to reach $80 billion by fiscal 2031 Artificial intelligence (AI) has unlocked massive growth opportunities for Marvell, as it has for other tech companies.
In its most recent fiscal year, which ended in January, the company's revenue totaled $8.2 billion, which was up an impressive 42% year over year.
However, in the longer run, by fiscal 2031, management expects revenue to be around $80 billion.

itens.titulo: B3 lança quatro contratos futuros de Treasuries para negociação em reais
itens.descricao: B3 lança quatro contratos futuros de Treasuries para negociação em reais InfoMoney
trechos: Publicidade A B3 (B3SA3) inicia nesta terça-feira (13) a negociação de quatro novos contratos futuros de Treasuries, os títulos da dívida pública dos Estados Unidos.

Os novos contratos são: futuros de US Treasury Note de 2 anos (T02), US Treasury Note de 5 anos (T05), US Treasury Note de 10 anos Ultra (T1U) e US Treasury Bond (TBN), voltado a prazos mais longos, acima de 20 anos.
Os futuros de US Treasury de 2 anos têm valor de face de US$ 200 mil e os demais de US$ 100 mil.
Ela é calculada por meio da família de índices B3 Dívida Externa Americana para cada segmento de Treasuries.
A chegada dos novos Contratos Futuros à B3 ocorre em um cenário de alta dos juros americanos e consequente valorização das Treasuries.
Em 16 de setembro, o Federal Reserve, banco central dos Estados Unidos, elevou a faixa da taxa básica em 0,25 ponto percentual, para 3,75% a 4% ao ano, como resposta à inflação elevada.
Segundo dados do Tesouro americano, a taxa de referência das Treasuries de 10 anos passou de 4,78% ao ano em 4 de setembro para 5,31% em 5 de outubro.
Na mesma data, as referências de 2 e 30 anos estavam em 4,84% e 5,66% ao ano, respectivamente.

itens.titulo: Nvidia (NVDA) Was Among Claude AI’s Top Picks This Year. Can The Stock Keep Rising?
itens.descricao: Nvidia (NVDA) Was Among Claude AI’s Top Picks This Year. Can The Stock Keep Rising? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Catalyst 1: Vera Rubin Could Be Nvidia's Fastest Ramp Yet Nvidia expects Vera Rubin, its next AI platform after Blackwell, to make up roughly 20% of data center revenue in the fiscal third quarter.
Catalyst 2: A New $200 Billion CPU Market Nvidia's Vera processor opens the central processor market to the company, which CEO Jensen Huang puts at $200 billion.
Vera could bring in $20 billion of sales this fiscal year, Huang said.
Catalyst 3: Customers Get Help Paying for Data Centers An AI data center needs land, power and cooling on top of the chips, and many customers need outside money to build one.
It has signed memorandums of understanding with six big financial companies to attract funding, with a target of $500 billion that is not yet secured.
It also gives credit support on some deals and has guaranteed up to $105 billion for an Ohio data center campus built for an OpenAI affiliate.
Networking revenue grew 199% year over year in the April quarter, and networking orders often come months before new data centers open.
The $105 billion guarantee is the ceiling on its gross exposure, and OpenAI has agreed to cover some losses.

itens.titulo: Is Coca-Cola (KO) Stock Outpacing Its Consumer Staples Peers This Year?
itens.descricao: Is Coca-Cola (KO) Stock Outpacing Its Consumer Staples Peers This Year? Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: Coca-Cola is one of 187 companies in the Consumer Staples group.
The Consumer Staples group currently sits at #15 within the Zacks Sector Rank.
The Zacks Sector Rank considers 16 different groups, measuring the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the sector to gauge the strength of each group.
Coca-Cola is currently sporting a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy).
The Zacks Consensus Estimate for KO's full-year earnings has moved 1% higher within the past quarter.
Based on the latest available data, KO has gained about 28.4% so far this year.
Meanwhile, the Consumer Staples sector has returned an average of 7.8% on a year-to-date basis.
Since the beginning of the year, the stock has returned 18%.

itens.titulo: Dólar opera em alta, com foco em preços do petróleo e novas pesquisas eleitorais no Brasil; Ibovespa cai
itens.descricao: Dólar opera em alta, com foco em preços do petróleo e novas pesquisas eleitorais no Brasil; Ibovespa cai G1
trechos: O dólar opera em alta nesta terça-feira (13), volta do feriado de Nossa Senhora Aparecida.
Perto das 11h, a moeda subia 0,62%, cotada R$ 5,0153.
Já o Ibovespa, principal índice da bolsa brasileira, tinha queda de 0,80% no mesmo horário, aos 207.384 pontos.
Na última sexta-feira, o índice bateu um novo recorde de fechamento, aos 209.067 pontos (+1,38%).

Após um novo levantamento do Datafolha indicar que Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) tem 49% das intenções de voto, enquanto Lula (PT) tem 45%, o mercado aguarda duas novas pesquisas com projeções para o 2º turno nesta semana.
O fundo ainda manteve a perspectiva de desaceleração da atividade econômica em 2027, atribuindo o movimento ao efeito dos juros elevados, à redução do estímulo fiscal e às incertezas globais.
Perto das 11h, o barril do Brent, referência internacional, caía 1,28%, cotado a US$ 105,28.
Já o West Texas Intermediate (WTI), referência nos EUA, recuava 0,79%, a US$ 93,00 o barril.
